name: Paracetamol 500mg Tablets
description: A common over-the-counter medicine used for mild to moderate pain and to help reduce fever. A staple of the home medicine cabinet.
usageInfo: Always read the label and use only as directed. Speak to the Medivyx team about what suits your situation.

name: Ibuprofen 400mg Tablets
description: A widely used anti-inflammatory medicine for pain and inflammation, such as headaches, period pain and muscle strains.
usageInfo: Take with or after food as directed. Not suitable for everyone — ask the pharmacy team before use.

name: Amoxicillin 500mg Capsules
description: A prescription antibiotic. Antibiotics at Medivyx are dispensed only against a valid prescription reviewed by the pharmacy team.
usageInfo: Prescription required. Antibiotics must only be used as prescribed — never share or reuse leftover courses.

name: Cetirizine 10mg Tablets
description: A non-drowsy antihistamine commonly used for hay fever, allergies and skin reactions such as hives.
usageInfo: Always read the label. Some people experience mild drowsiness — check with the team if unsure.

name: ORS — Oral Rehydration Salts
description: Sachets of oral rehydration salts mixed with clean water to help replace fluids and salts lost through diarrhoea or dehydration.
usageInfo: Dissolve one sachet in the stated amount of clean water as directed. Especially useful for families with young children.

name: Cough Syrup — Honey & Lemon
description: A soothing honey and lemon cough syrup for the relief of irritating coughs. Suitable for the whole family.
usageInfo: Use as directed on the packaging. Ask the team about options for young children.

name: Antacid Chewable Tablets
description: Fast-acting chewable tablets that help neutralise stomach acid and ease heartburn and indigestion.
usageInfo: Chew thoroughly as directed. If symptoms persist, speak to the pharmacy team.

name: Metformin 500mg Tablets
description: A prescription medicine used in the management of type 2 diabetes. Dispensed only against a valid prescription.
usageInfo: Prescription required. Take exactly as prescribed and keep the pharmacy team informed of any changes.

name: Daily Multivitamin Tablets
description: A balanced daily multivitamin to help support general nutrition, especially when dietary intake is inconsistent.
usageInfo: Take as directed with food. Supplements support — not replace — a balanced diet.

name: Vitamin C 1000mg
description: A high-strength vitamin C supplement to support the normal function of the immune system.
usageInfo: Take as directed. If you take other medicines, check timing with the pharmacy team.

name: Ferrous Sulphate + Folic Acid
description: A commonly used iron and folic acid supplement, often recommended alongside antenatal care.
usageInfo: Take as advised by your healthcare provider. The team can share tips on taking iron comfortably.

name: Zinc Supplement Tablets
description: Zinc supports the normal function of the immune system and is commonly used as part of recovery support.
usageInfo: Take as directed on the label. Ask the team about combining supplements safely.

name: Baby Paracetamol Syrup 120mg/5ml
description: A gentle paracetamol syrup formulated for infants and young children, for pain and fever relief.
usageInfo: Always follow the age and weight dosing on the label. Ask the pharmacy team if you are unsure.

name: Baby Vitamin D Drops
description: Vitamin D drops formulated for infants to support normal bone development.
usageInfo: Use as directed on the packaging. Ideal for babies from birth as part of daily care.

name: Petroleum Jelly — Baby 100g
description: A gentle barrier jelly that protects delicate baby skin from dryness and irritation.
usageInfo: Apply to clean, dry skin as needed. For external use only.

name: Baby Wipes — Fragrance-Free
description: Soft, fragrance-free wipes for gentle everyday cleansing of baby skin.
usageInfo: Reseal the pack after use. Suitable for sensitive skin.

name: Infant Nasal Saline Drops
description: Sterile saline drops that help soften and clear nasal congestion in infants.
usageInfo: Use as directed. Gentle enough for daily use during colds.

name: Antiseptic Solution 250ml
description: A general-purpose antiseptic solution for cleansing minor cuts, grazes and wounds.
usageInfo: Dilute and apply as directed on the label. Seek medical help for deep or dirty wounds.

name: Hand Sanitizer 500ml
description: An alcohol-based hand rub for cleaning hands when soap and water are not available.
usageInfo: Apply a coin-sized amount and rub until dry. Keep away from young children.

name: Medical Face Masks — Box of 50
description: Single-use medical face masks for personal protection in crowded or clinical settings.
usageInfo: Fit snugly, avoid touching the front, and dispose safely after use.

name: Fluoride Toothpaste 100ml
description: Daily fluoride toothpaste that helps protect against cavities and keeps breath fresh.
usageInfo: Brush twice daily. Ask the team about children’s options.

name: Aloe Vera Gel 200ml
description: A cooling aloe vera gel that soothes dry, tight or sun-exposed skin.
usageInfo: Apply generously to clean skin. For external use only.

name: Digital Thermometer
description: A fast, easy-to-read digital thermometer for checking body temperature at home.
usageInfo: Clean before and after use. Ask the team which reading method suits your family best.

name: Home First Aid Kit
description: A curated kit of first aid essentials — plasters, gauze, bandages, antiseptic, tape and scissors.
usageInfo: Keep in a cool, dry place, out of reach of children. Restock items after use.

name: Blood Pressure Monitor
description: An automatic upper-arm blood pressure monitor for convenient monitoring at home.
usageInfo: Sit still and follow the device instructions. Share your readings with your healthcare provider.

name: Disposable Gloves — Box
description: Boxed disposable gloves for hygiene and protection during first aid or care at home.
usageInfo: Single use only. Dispose of safely after each task.

name: Glucose Test Strips
description: Glucose test strips compatible with standard home glucose meters for regular monitoring.
usageInfo: Check compatibility with your meter. Store in the original container away from heat.
